ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Fraud in Minnesota's Welfare System
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent allegations of industrial-scale fraud in Minnesota's welfare system, tracking the money and uncovering the patterns and connections between entities and programs.
ideas.angle: Investigative reporting on government waste and corruption
questions: What are the root causes of the fraud?
How much money has been lost?
What steps are being taken to prevent similar incidents in the future?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose widespread corruption and waste in the government's management of public funds. By following the money and tracking the patterns and connections between entities and programs, we can uncover the truth behind the allegations and hold those responsible accountable.
